author: Akien
prose: i had typed you a reply about when i worked at broadcom, but it got lost. short of it: each commit kicked off most relevant tests. but not everything. an hourly test kinda like a broad smoke test ran. each evening, a full suite of everything but the longest running tests (40 hours). each friday evening, the whole suite. i am not saying we should follow this model, but perhaps there are useful ideas in it for our own testing. thoughts?
